takeaways.text: Advertising revenue rose 24% to $38.7B — 97 cents of every dollar Meta made — on 21% more ad impressions and a 2% higher average price per ad. Reality Labs chipped in $1,071M of revenue but lost $4,646M.
takeaways.title: Ads surged in the holiday quarter

takeaways.text: Revenue rose 25% while total costs and expenses fell 8%, so operating margin widened to 41% from 20% a year ago and net income tripled to $14.0B — free cash flow was $11.5B, and Meta ended the year with $65.4B of cash and marketable securities.
takeaways.title: The efficiency year paid off

takeaways.text: Meta declared its first-ever dividend — $0.50 a share, payable March 26, 2024 — and added $50B to its buyback authorization, after repurchasing $6.32B of stock in the quarter. Headcount was 67,317, down 22% from a year earlier.
takeaways.title: A first-ever dividend

verdict: Meta's revenue rose 25% to $40.1B in the holiday quarter as ad impressions jumped 21%, and with total costs down 8% in its 'year of efficiency', profit tripled to $14.0B — and Meta declared its first-ever dividend.
